about: Images of the blog redrawn in the series' light, pastel hand-drawn look (ink and watercolor on white paper) with GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst through Runway (krizaka-internal#2455). Prompts, references, takes and the credits the account showed; the files are on Bunny, never committed. A first round (a darker, richer dusk look) was set aside by the founder on 2026-11-05 as too far from chapters 1 to 20.

characters.chouf: a small orange-brown kestrel (the watcher, watchdog.py): perched, looking down the tracks
characters.pompier: a small red duck with round glasses (the firefighter, since replaced by the crack): on the siding beside the fire
characters.pigeon: a small blue-grey rock pigeon, which delivers (the letterbox)

references: the first-round cover of chapter 23 (scene and characters to keep)
series-23-the-trains-second-version-rail.prompt:
Use the first three reference pictures only for their style: a light, airy hand-drawn illustration on white paper, lots of unpainted white paper left around and inside the scene, soft pale transparent watercolor washes (pale blue, pale indigo, peach, light orange, cream), a light bright sky or none, delicate thin pen-and-ink linework of varying weight with some broken lines, gentle muted pastel colour, a few small touches of stronger colour only on the characters and one lamp. No dark night, no heavy saturated shadows, no photographic detail, no digital smoothness. Absolutely not a cartoon: no big eyes, no cel shading, no flat vector fills, no glossy gradients, no clothes on the animals. Birds are small, drawn naturalistically with a few ink strokes. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
The last reference picture shows the scene and the characters to keep exactly (same composition, same kestrel on the signal post, same red duck with round glasses beside the repair draisine with its lantern, same wagon on the siding under a red lamp, same station): redraw it in the light pastel style of the first three, at the end of a pale winter day with a soft pale peach and blue sky and snow left as white paper.
